_comment: CURATED REGISTER — verified 10 Sep 2026. Your editorial layer. Add/verify entries here; every entry carries a real source URL.

datacentres.name: Waltham Cross data centre
datacentres.note: ~£790m ($1bn) for this 33-acre site (announced Jan 2024). Separate from Google's wider two-year £5bn UK programme — keep the two figures distinct.

datacentres.name: Cambois / Blyth AI data centre
datacentres.note: ~£10bn. 10 halls (~72MW each, ~720MW total) over ~133 acres on the former Britishvolt site; billed as Europe's largest; final phase possibly 2035.

datacentres.name: UK data centre programme
datacentres.note: £8bn over five years (2024-2028) building and operating data centres. Location shown is regional, not a single site.

datacentres.name: Skelton Grange hyperscale campus
datacentres.note: Microsoft campus on former Skelton Grange power station site; ~500,000 sq ft across three halls; ~£4bn inward investment estimated on completion, off a £106.6m land deal with Harworth.

datacentres.name: Cockenzie hyperscale (former coal store)
datacentres.note: London-based UK firm SDCL named preferred supplier for a potential JV with East Lothian Council; very early stage, planning and consultation to come. Eventual operator TBC — could be a US hyperscaler.
